carouser.summary: Raised in a big city like Baldur's Gate, you spent your nights in taverns, theaters and gambling halls, coaxing secrets out of people at card tables and fancy parties.

vampire-devotee.summary: You served a vampire or a small coven as a willing aspirant or a charmed thrall, fed on again and again, until your time in their lair came to an end.

vampire-survivor.summary: You lived through or watched a vampire attack, frozen or fighting, and now stay ever watchful so no monster catches you or your friends unready again.
